hero.caption:
Epping Station, with Ongar auto-train and LT Central Line train.
View SW, towards Loughton, Stratford and London on the ex-GER suburban line from Liverpool Street, continuing on to Ongar. From 26/9/49 LPTB Central Line terminated here, from Ealing Broadway/West Ruislip. The service on to Ongar then continued as a steam shuttle until 11/57, when it was electrified, but ceased on 30/9/94.
